prompt_text: What is a good martial arts school for kids in St. Peters MO?
answer_verbatim:
A good place to start is **Onyx Grappling**, at **953 Jungermann Road**. It offers kids’ Brazilian jiu-jitsu classes focused on confidence, discipline, and practical self-defense, and advertises a free introductory class. Call **(636) 339-4277** to confirm age groups and current class times. [Kids program](https://onyxgrappling.com/programs/) · [Location and contact](https://onyxgrappling.com/about-us/)

If you’d like to compare styles, **World Martial Arts Academy** offers youth taekwondo for ages 6–17 at **1057 Cave Springs Blvd**. [Details](https://www.taekwondoclasses.net/missouri/st-peters/)

I’d visit or observe a class before enrolling, and ask about instructor experience with children, supervision during sparring, and the full cost—including uniforms and testing fees.
